description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya Yaya 01, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110177
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of multiple land parcels. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels with their extent, ownership details, and title classifications, all falling under the Registration of Title Act. This fits the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and other land-related administrative matters.
